verdict.rationale: The ADK docs say the framework is "designed to be written by both humans and AI" and point coding assistants to "ADK developer Skills and AI-aware developer resources". Several evidence items are sourced from markdown versions of doc pages (adk.dev/.../index.md), which suggests agent-readable docs exist. However, no llms.txt is evidenced: the probes hit the google.github.io root and a malformed .md path rather than the adk.dev docs host, so they neither confirm nor contradict one. Missing for 10: a documented llms.txt or llms-full.txt, explicit documentation of the markdown or AI-resource endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can consume them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: ADK is designed to be written by both humans and AI. Connect your favorite coding assistant to our ADK developer Skills and AI-aware developer resources
Use your favorite AI-enabled developer environment to scaffold, build, test, evaluate, and deploy with Agents CLI.
